name: Travel time
description: Travel time to work in the morning and home in the afternoon, for up to three people, from travel-time sensors in Home Assistant (Waze Travel Time, Google Maps Travel Time). A delay against what is normal for that weekday and time shows as +x min. Hidden at the weekend if you like. Requires the Home Assistant Core plugin.

cell_options.name: person_1_name
cell_options.label: Person 1: name
cell_options.help: Shown on the page. Blank uses the sensor's name. Kept as a secret, like the sensors: never in the page's markup or an exported template.

cell_options.name: person_1_to_work
cell_options.label: Person 1: to work
cell_options.help: A travel-time sensor in Home Assistant (Waze Travel Time, Google Maps Travel Time, or any sensor in minutes) from home to work.

cell_options.name: person_1_to_home
cell_options.label: Person 1: home
cell_options.help: The same, from work to home.

cell_options.name: switch_hour
cell_options.label: Home from
cell_options.help: Before this hour the page shows the way to work, from it the way home.

cell_options.name: weekend
cell_options.label: At the weekend
cell_options.help: Hidden, the cell stays empty on Saturday and Sunday. For a page that gives the room to something else at the weekend, schedule a weekend page of its own.

cell_options.name: delay_min
cell_options.label: Show a delay from
cell_options.help: How much longer than normal before the page says so.

cell_options.name: baseline_weeks
cell_options.label: Normal is the median of the last
cell_options.help: Normal is the median of the same sensor on the same weekday at the same time of day, from Home Assistant's history (the recorder keeps 10 days by default: raise purge_keep_days, or the long-term statistics fill in). Until there is enough history the delay is left out.

cell_options.name: show_route
cell_options.label: Roads
cell_options.help: The road numbers of the route (A2 · A12), when the sensor gives them.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Blank: 'Travel time to work' or 'Travel time home' in the display language.

cell_options.name: language
cell_options.label: Language
cell_options.help: The widget's words in this language, whatever the dashboard's. Set the same on every widget of a page for one language throughout.
